data.name: TranslationLabel
data.comment: Heads the translated section of a tooltip; also the accessible name of the translation box.

data.name: TranslateIntoLabel
data.comment: The underscore marks the access key.

data.name: ServiceUpdating
data.value: The translation service is being updated. Try again in a few minutes.

data.name: TookTooLong
data.value: The translation took too long and was stopped.

data.name: ServiceUnavailable
data.value: The translation service is not available. Try again.

data.name: TextTooLong
data.value: The text is too long. Up to {0} characters can be translated at a time.
data.comment: {0}: the largest number of characters, already formatted.

data.name: NoModel
data.value: No language model is installed yet. Download it from the bar at the top of Visual Studio.

data.name: InvalidLanguage
data.value: The language chosen is not one that can be translated into.

data.name: CloudConsent
data.value: Only an online service can translate this, and it is not allowed.

data.name: NothingTranslated
data.value: Nothing was translated. The text may already be in this language.

data.name: PartlyTranslated
data.value: Some parts could not be translated and are left as they were.

data.name: ModelOffer
data.value: Visual Studio Translator can translate documentation into {0} entirely on this computer. That needs a one-time download of a language model ({1}) from {2}, which then serves every language. Nothing from your code is sent.
data.comment: {0}: the language's own name; {1}: a size such as 'about 5.0 GB'; {2}: the host the model comes from.

data.name: ModelInstalled
data.value: Language model installed. Documentation is translated as you hover.

data.name: ModelInstallFailed
data.value: The language model could not be installed.

data.name: DownloadingProgress
data.value: Downloading the language model: {0} of {1} MB
data.comment: {0} and {1}: megabytes downloaded and in all, already formatted.

data.name: SettingsDescription
data.value: Translation of code documentation into your language.

data.name: SettingsLocalTranslationDescription
data.value: The language model that translates on this computer, without sending your code anywhere.

data.name: SettingsTranslateTooltipsDescription
data.value: Translates the text of tooltips, such as documentation, when you hover over code, in any programming language.

data.name: SettingsTargetLanguageDescription
data.value: The language documentation is translated into. By default, the language Visual Studio is shown in.

data.name: SettingsModelDescription
data.value: The model that translates on this computer. One that is not downloaded yet is offered for download the next time a translation is needed; a model downloaded before stays, so switching back costs nothing.

data.name: SettingsUseGraphicsCardDescription
data.value: Runs the model on the fastest graphics card that works, several times faster than on the processor. Turn off to keep the card free for other work.

data.name: SettingsTranslateErrorsDescription
data.value: Translates the messages of errors and warnings shown when you hover over underlined code, along with the rest of the tooltip.
